test_runs.selector: SDK handler ownership, production construction, exact local effects, provider boundaries, and binding failures
negative_cases: Missing or unknown local handler ownership fails closed.
Local construction cannot impersonate external-provider operations.
Cross-binding project, session, task, model, and submodel payloads fail closed.
HIL wiring is verified against a fake service without invoking live HIL.

test_runs.selector: Python lint, compile, and whitespace validation
negative_cases: Malformed Python or whitespace cannot pass.
No Git, install, helper, tunnel, candidate, HIL, pointer, or root-spawned subagent action is included.

limitations: The separate full public-surface matrix still reports a pre-existing hook-package inventory mismatch of 11 live versus 9 declared; public-surface rows own that correction.
Provider-owned host Plan, host-entry, headless, and ENV/UOP operations remain explicit external contracts.
Row220 owns service-route review and Row221 owns public skill/MCP parity.
